name: JG_ZZ_TA_CC_RANGES
description: This table stores the journal allocation cost center ranges.  There is a one-to-many relationship between a rule set and cost center ranges.  This table corresponds to Cost Center Ranges zone of the Journal Allocation Rules form.  Not currently used.

columns.description: Cost range defining column

columns.name: RULE_SET_ID
columns.description: Rule Set defining column

columns.name: CC_RANGE_LOW
columns.description: Low Cost Center value of range

columns.description: High Cost Center value of range

columns.name: DESCRIPTION

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
